text:
liz: heads-up — seeing ~2s coldstart spikes in python workers when the OTLP exporter does per-tenant fanout. kv-cache spans stall while exporter reconnects.

liz: minimal repro:
```
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import BatchSpanProcessor
from opentelemetry.exporter.otlp.proto.grpc.trace_exporter import OTLPSpanExporter

provider = TracerProvider()
provider.add_span_processor(BatchSpanProcessor(OTLPSpanExporter(endpoint=collector)))
```
This executes exporter init synchronously on import in our service entrypoint.

raj: seeing same in Go. our init calls exporter.Dial() during bootstrap which blocks on TLS handshake + auth token fetch. causes startup to wait for collector.

sam: rust runtime worked around by spawning a background worker for the exporter, but queue gets backpressured and we end up dropping spans under load.

sam: metrics show spikes in `spans_dropped_total` when the exporter queue hits capacity.

olga: we tried an agent/proxy to absorb fanout but it still created N connections per tenant downstream. could we multiplex tenant metadata over a single gRPC channel instead? OTLP supports metadata per request (eg `x-tenant-id`).

dinesh: careful — lazy init + buffering can blow up memory if many tenants bootstrap at once. propose bounded disk-backed queue (lz4 chunks) with eviction policy and per-tenant max bytes.

liz: +1 on disk-backed fallback. also the sampling semantics are messy: sdk-level sampler vs backend sampling. our control plane decides tenant sampling rates. sdk should send a sampling hint attribute rather than doing final drop.

raj: proposal for a cross-lang shim (py/go/rust):
  1) lazy non-blocking exporter init (worker thread/goroutine/task)
  2) single multiplexed connection to collector/agent, tenant id in request metadata
  3) per-tenant bounded in-memory queue with optional disk spill
  4) backpressure policy: when queue full, drop oldest spans + emit `spans_dropped` and `queue_overflow` metrics per-tenant
  5) expose a `sampling_hint` attribute the control plane can set via config

raj: i'll prototype the Go shim and push RFC.

sam: also make sure shutdown drains with configurable timeout — we saw SIGTERM kill before BatchSpanProcessor finished flush.

olga: add exporter_health metric exposed to console, and add canary UX for new exporter configs so ops can roll out multiplexing gradually per-tenant.

dinesh: for disk queue we should add a compacted manifest and scrub old tenant blobs when retention exceeded. console should show per-tenant queue depth + disk usage.

liz: agreed. owner list: raj -> Go shim prototype + RFC, sam -> drain tests + rust integration, dinesh -> disk-backed queue POC, olga -> console metrics + rollout hooks, i'll coordinate RFC + sync.

deploy-bot: created issue #INFR-7422 linking prototype PRs and added assignees.

liz: thanks everyone. next step: raj to post PR link in this thread when ready. if anyone has quick objections to multiplexing metadata over single connection speak now. otherwise proceed. :thumbsup:
